body.condition: For the design theorem, every row of \(T_{e,x}\) equals an edge-specific vector \(t_e\in O_C(\eta_0)\) in the fixed stratum \(x\).

novel.justification: The submodel describes trials whose treatment-side proxy does not refine the observed distribution of the adjustment proxy after conditioning on the covariate stratum; edge-to-edge latent mixtures still generate distinct attainable rows.
